name: HeyGen
tagline: HeyGen is an AI video creation platform that lets you produce professional presenter videos with AI avatars that speak any script in 40+ languages. You can clone your own voice and likeness or choose from over 100 pre-built avatars, making HeyGen popular for corporate training, product demos, and multilingual content at scale. Its lip-sync quality is considered among the best in the industry.
